kuaishou-search-2 v0.1.0

- Initial release of the kuaishou-search skill.
- Provides structured Kuaishou data retrieval: keyword video search, creator post listing, and video comment fetching.
- Designed for open Kuaishou data analysis—suitable for trend tracking, competitor research, KOL screening, and content insights.
- Supports high-volume results, multi-dimensional filtering, and batch operations.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for API access.
